name: Bashir Aremu
headline: I test web apps, APIs and AI agents the way an attacker would.
intro: I build web systems, secure them, and automate that security into the pipeline.
description: Bashir Aremu is an application security and DevSecOps engineer and a full-stack software engineer, working on web and API penetration testing, AI red teaming and bug bounty recon.
whoami: Bashir Aremu. Application security and DevSecOps engineer, and full-stack software engineer.
about: I test web applications and APIs for security flaws at TraceWorka Innovative Solutions, where I've been an Application Security Engineer since March 2025.
Since November 2026 I've held a second role alongside it: AI Red Team Specialist at BLEND.
I'm also a full-stack software engineer, so I know how these systems get built and where the shortcuts usually are.
I also do AI red teaming (prompt injection and agent security) and recon for bug bounty programs.
focusIntro: The three kinds of security work I do.

focus.title: Web and API penetration testing
focus.body: This is my day job. I test web applications and APIs for security flaws, then write up what I found, what it puts at risk and how to fix it.

focus.title: AI red teaming
focus.body: I test LLM applications and agents for prompt injection, and for what an attacker can get an agent to do with the tools and data it can reach.

focus.title: Bug bounty recon
focus.body: Before testing a target I work out what it exposes to the internet. I do this for bug bounty programs in my own time.

contactIntro: For security work, a red-team program, or a question about something I've written, email is the best way to reach me.
